name: Sender Blocklist Processor
description: Marks mail from blocked senders or domains as junk (gray)
author: MailFlow community
readme:
## Sender Blocklist Processor

A cheap, deterministic pre-filter that marks mail from unwanted senders or domains as junk (gray / `ad`) before any LLM work — exact sender addresses and full domains are matched case-insensitively.

### Features

- Exact sender-address matches and domain-suffix matches
- No LLM involved; runs in milliseconds

### Usage

```toml
[[processors]]
processor_id = "blocklist"
provider = "blocklist"
priority = 5              # run before the rules processor
retries = 0
[processors.options]
senders = ["spam@example.com"]
domains = ["spammy-newsletter.example"]
```

### License

MIT — contributions welcome.

## mailflow-processor-blocklist

把来自黑名单发件人或域名的邮件标记为灰色（ad）级别，减少打扰。列表支持通配符域（如 `*.spam.example`）。

### 特性

- 精确地址与通配符域名匹配
- 命中时给出清晰的处理说明，便于审计
- 纯函数式，无外部依赖

### 配置

```toml
[[processors]]
processor_id = "blocklist"
provider = "blocklist"
enabled = true
[processors.options]
blocked = ["spammer@example.com", "*.spam.example"]
```

### 协议

MIT — 欢迎贡献。
